item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:15 HKT 08/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be cool in the morning and mainly fine over the region. The monsoon will moderate midweek this week. Temperatures over the coast of southern China will rise slightly and it will be cloudier. Under the influence of another surge of the northeast monsoon, temperatures over the coast of southern China is expected to fall progressively in the latter part of this week. It will be cool in the morning and at night. It will be windy.
